q1.explanationZh: 文章开头说泰勒不只是好音乐，还是力量的来源，后面用两位中国粉丝的故事说明她怎样影响粉丝。所以作者想表现泰勒对粉丝的影响。

evidence.quote: Taylor Swift means much more than just great music.

q2.explanationZh: 第一段把世界各地的 “Swifties” 和泰勒联系在一起，说明 Swifties 就是泰勒的粉丝。

evidence.quote: To the hundreds of millions of “Swifties” around the world, Taylor Swift means much more than just great music.

q3.explanationZh: Huang Shiyao 现在 25 岁，14 岁开始喜欢泰勒，25 − 14 = 11，所以是 11 年。

evidence.quote: My love for Taylor Swift began when I was 14.

q4.explanationZh: 她说泰勒从小镇搬到大城市追梦，这点激励了她也想去大城市，所以起初喜欢泰勒是因为泰勒离开小镇去追梦。

evidence.quote: At the age of 14, she moved to a larger city to chase her dream of becoming a musician.

q5.explanationZh: Huang Weijie 说多亏泰勒，他开始写下自己的感受，也就是养成了记录感受的习惯。

evidence.quote: Thanks to her, I started writing down my own feelings

q6.explanationZh: 两个人都从泰勒的歌和故事里得到了力量（③）；Huang Shiyao 14 岁开始喜欢泰勒，Huang Weijie 喜欢了 7 年、现在 20 岁，也是十几岁时开始的（④）。①②文中没有同时说到两人。

evidence.quote: My love for Taylor Swift began when I was 14.
It has been seven years since I first watched Taylor Swift’s music videos.
